calls.title: Growthbook <> Homa - Intro
calls.summary: Wilma's team is establishing a digital growth function as they prepare for a new website launch in seven to eight months. New digital leadership focuses on growth marketing, including paid media, SEO, and personalization, despite minimal headcount. The current website will remain active during this transition, with an emphasis on quick experimentation to guide the upcoming site build. Budget constraints demand creative experimentation to enhance website performance without increasing costs. Wilma seeks a user-friendly experimentation tool with fast setup and visual editing capabilities. GrowthBook is a potential fit due to its integration with existing analytics tools and flexible pricing models that can accommodate Wilma's needs. The team plans to conduct further demos and evaluations to ensure a swift onboarding process.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, Digital Transformation, GrowthBook, GA4 Integration, Visual Editor, Pricing Models
